tools.name: pypi_package
tools.description:
PyPI metadata for a package: latest version, license, requires_python, first and latest
        upload dates, number of non-yanked releases, and runtime dependencies (extras excluded).

tools.name: pypi_releases
tools.description:
Release history of a PyPI package, newest first. Includes total_releases and
        releases_per_year (non-yanked releases, pre-releases included, dated by first upload).
        Pass year to list only that calendar year.

tools.name: pypi_version
tools.description: Metadata for one specific version of a PyPI package: requires_python, dependencies, upload date.

tools.description: List files and folders at a path in a GitHub repository (default branch). Empty path = root.

tools.description: Read a text file from a GitHub repository (default branch), truncated to max_chars.

tools.name: github_workflow_runs
